name: DESAR Stage Configuration
description: Production stage configuration for a Design Master. Each row = one production stage. The system reads this table to determine Work Order sequence, QI button behavior, Roll Ticket creation, and Repack triggering. Adding a row here adds a new production stage without any code change.

fields.label: Seq
fields.description: Stage sequence number. Determines production order.

fields.label: Stage Name
fields.description: Human-readable name. e.g. Warping, Weaving, Dyeing, Finishing, Packing

fields.label: Output Item
fields.description: Item produced by this stage. Warping→Warping Beam, Weaving→Grey Roll, etc.

fields.label: Output Qty
fields.description: Quantity produced per production run. Usually 1 for intermediate items, 50 for final.

fields.label: QI Required
fields.description: If checked, DESAR QC button appears on this stage's Work Order after completion.

fields.label: QI Template
fields.description: QI template to use when inspector creates inspection for this stage.

fields.label: Sample Size
fields.description: How many pieces to inspect. 1=one roll, wo_qty=all pieces, wo_qty*0.1=10%

fields.label: Creates Roll Ticket
fields.description: If checked, submitting Manufacture SE for this stage auto-creates a Roll Ticket.

fields.label: Skip Material Transfer
fields.description: If checked, raw materials are backflushed automatically. No Transfer SE needed. Use for intermediate stages (Warping, Weaving). Uncheck for stages requiring physical confirmation (Finishing, Packing).

fields.label: Is Final Stage
fields.description: If checked, submitting QI for this stage triggers Repack SE auto-creation.

fields.label: Can Split
fields.description: If checked, this stage output can be split and fed to multiple parallel Work Orders.

fields.label: Operations
fields.description: Operations performed in this stage. Each operation maps to an ERPNext Job Card.

fields.label: BOM
fields.description: Auto-filled when Create All BOMs is clicked on the Design Master.
